in_marathi.name: Anchal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anchal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anchal is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Anchala', which means 'calm' or 'graceful'. In Hindu mythology, Anchal is associated with the goddess Shakti, who represents strength, compassion, and grace.
